key.name: always-visible
key.description: Keep the top bar icon visible even when everything is up to date. When disabled, the indicator only appears when outdated packages or errors are reported.

key.name: boot-wait
key.description: Grace period after login before the first package check, to keep session startup snappy.

key.name: check-interval
key.description: Time between two package checks. The default mirrors the 7-hour cycle of the Xbar/SwiftBar plugin: checks are resource intensive and package managers like Homebrew may hit GitHub API quotas when refreshed too often.

key.name: mpm-command
key.description: Command used to invoke mpm, parsed with shell syntax (so a multi-word launcher like "uv run mpm" works). Leave empty to autodetect mpm from PATH and well-known install locations.

key.name: notify
key.summary: Notify when new outdated packages appear
key.description: Send a desktop notification when a check reports outdated packages that were not in the previous report.

key.name: post-upgrade-recheck
key.description: Delay before refreshing the package list after an upgrade is launched. Terminal windows detach from the process actually running the upgrade, so completion cannot be tracked directly.

key.name: show-count
key.description: Display the number of outdated packages next to the indicator icon.

key.name: submenu-layout
key.description: Mirror of the Xbar/SwiftBar plugin VAR_SUBMENU_LAYOUT variable: collapse each package manager section into its own submenu instead of listing everything inline.

key.name: terminal-command
key.description: Terminal emulator used to run upgrades, parsed with shell syntax. The upgrade command is appended as extra arguments, so the prefix must accept a trailing argv: use each terminal's argv form, like "gnome-terminal --", "alacritty -e", "xfce4-terminal -x" or plain "foot". Console (kgx) is the exception, served by its dedicated dialect when autodetected. Leave empty to autodetect (xdg-terminal-exec, ptyxis, kgx, then gnome-terminal).

key.name: timeout
key.description: Value passed to mpm --timeout for background checks. mpm defaults are tuned for interactive runs and are too long for a top bar refresh.

key.name: upgrade-in-terminal
key.description: Open a terminal window for upgrade commands so their progress can be followed and sudo can prompt for a password. When disabled, upgrades run silently in the background, which requires passwordless escalation for system package managers: see https://kdeldycke.github.io/meta-package-manager/sudo.html
